Let’s Start with a Quick Rant
Ever notice how your phone buzzes nonstop all day? Order shipped, someone replied to your comment, that app you haven’t opened in three days desperately wants your attention again.
Sounds simple enough, right? Just send a message. How hard can it be?
Now try doing it for one billion users, sending billions of notifications per day, peaking at hundreds of thousands per second — and oh by the way, verification codes absolutely must arrive within three seconds. Still think it’s easy?
Today we’ll start from the most naive approach and build it up layer by layer, talking about what breaks at each stage. Useful for interviews, and even more useful for not repeating my mistakes in production.
Version 1: Database + Cron Job (Baby’s First Notification System)
